name: Hurricane Ian — Southwest Florida Response Analysis
description: Historical reconstruction of Hurricane Ian's impact on Lee County using NOAA, USGS, Lee County and FEMA records, combined with a clearly labeled simulated emergency-response exercise.

disclosure.title: Historical Reconstruction + Simulated Emergency Response Exercise
disclosure.body: This demonstration combines publicly documented Hurricane Ian data with fictional emergency calls, dispatch records, responder movements, and operational scenarios. Simulated activity does not represent actual emergency-service decisions or movements. EventTruth is designed to analyze verified records supplied by authorized organizations.
